channel.description: Recent content in Multi-Agent on 梦兽编程

item.title: Collaboration modes: chat / task / single_turn, and the tools the framework installs for your model
item.description: How llmagent.Config.Mode lands in ADK Go v2.4.0: installTaskTools attaching a same-named delegation tool on the parent according to each sub-agent's mode, ModeTask receiving its own finish_task, the delegation tool's Name/Description/Parameters all coming from the agent configuration, the do-not-call-in-parallel sentence hardcoded into the task tool description, DefersResponse and the synthesizeTaskFREvent detour, the different IncludeContents default for a single_turn node, and using the nine TestDelegation_* cases as the specification.

item.title: The three fixed orchestration agents: Sequential / Parallel / Loop, their implementation semantics and boundaries
item.description: The three agent/workflowagents packages in ADK Go v2.4.0: Config wraps a single agent.Config (LoopAgent adds MaxIterations uint), all three reject a custom Run, Sequential's fixed ordering and RunLive entry point, Parallel's errgroup plus <parent>.<child> branch naming and early-stop cancellation with teardown waiting, Loop's count==0 indefinite loop and Actions.Escalate exit, and where the selection boundary lies against the graph workflow engine.

item.title: Module 6: New Multi-Agent Patterns (ADK Go 2.x)
item.description: The new behaviour of the workflowagents trio on top of the graph engine, plus llmagent's chat/task/single_turn collaboration modes and structured input/output

item.title: Companies Offer 30K for Agent Engineers, Demo Writers Can't Get Hired
item.description: Companies can't hire production-ready agent engineers at 30K a month while demo writers can't find jobs. We break the gap into four skill blocks, each backed by real production cases from Anthropic, Cognition, and AWS, plus three runnable code examples

item.title: Agent Clusters - When AI Starts 'Forming Squads'
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's multi-Agent architecture: three spawning methods - sub-Agents, Fork mode, and Coordinator mode - plus Agent Swarm collaboration and verification Agent mechanisms.

item.title: Building AI Agents in Rust (Part 5): Multi-Agent Crews
item.description: Part 5 covers multi-agent collaboration: when to add agents and when not to. The Agent trait, Crew parallel/sequential dispatch, Router, debate protocol, and composing with Part 3's skill registry and Part 4's state machine.

item.title: Module 5: Multi-Agent Collaboration
item.description: Team, Sequential, Parallel, Loop, Custom, Routing

item.title: Tokencake: Multi-Agent KV Cache Scheduling That Cuts vLLM Latency by Half
item.description: Beihang/Peking/Alibaba introduce Tokencake, a KV-cache-centric serving framework for multi-agent apps. With time+space scheduling plus CPU buffering and progressive GPU reservation, it trims end-to-end latency by 47%+ versus vLLM and lifts GPU cache utilization by ~17%.

item.title: Agno-Go: Building AI Agents in Go - What's it Like Being 16x Faster than Python?
item.description: Rewriting AI Agent framework in Go brings 16x performance boost, 180ns agent startup, and only 1.2KB memory footprint - this is the extreme experience Agno-Go delivers
